# Ana — The cautious first-timer

> "I just want to be sure I typed the right number."

## Overview
Ana rents her first flat and submits a meter reading once a year. Proto-persona: assumptions, not research.

## Job Story
**When** the reminder arrives, **I want to** submit the reading in one go, **so I can** stop worrying about the bill.

## Snapshot
- **Archetype:** The cautious first-timer
- **Role:** Tenant
- **Tech confidence:** medium — uses her phone for everything

## Goals
- **End goals:** Submit a correct reading before the deadline
- **Experience goals:** Feel sure nothing went wrong
- **Life goals:** Keep her finances predictable

## Thinking Style & Behaviors
- Double-checks every number before sending (A1)

## Behavioral Dimensions

| Dimension | 1 | 5 | Position |
|-----------|---|---|----------|
| Need for reassurance | none | constant | 4 |

## Needs & Pain Points

| # | Pain point | Current workaround | Need | Evidence |
|---|-----------|--------------------|------|----------|
| P1 | Unsure which number on the meter counts | Asks the landlord | Guidance at the point of entry | A2 |
| P2 | Fears a typo changes the bill | Takes a photo as proof | A review step | A1 |

## Context of Use
- **Devices & channels:** Phone, standing in front of the meter
- **Environment:** Dark basement, one hand free

## Accessibility & Inclusion
- **Situational:** Poor light, one-handed use

## Design Implications
- **Do:** Show the entered value again before submitting (P2)
- **Don't:** Hide the previous reading behind a tap (P1)

## Assumptions & Evidence

| # | Assumption | Evidence level | Source | How to validate |
|---|-----------|----------------|--------|-----------------|
| A1 | Tenants double-check numbers | assumption | team workshop | Interview five tenants |
| A2 | The meter display is confusing | signal | support tickets | Count tickets per month |

## Open Questions
- [ ] How many tenants submit on desktop?
